findings.condition: Nine active approved publications share one scope: one suitable older environment and eight newer different environments, with normal candidates=8.
findings.consequence: The suitable saved Skill is invisible and selectSkill returns no_approved_candidate; a caller following the documented fallback needlessly queues slow generation.
